vars.subject: car handling (the Car class in scripts/Car.cs: throttle, drag, braking, reverse, steering and the grass)
vars.rules: throttle accelerates the car along its heading in proportion to how far it is pressed, the top speed is Accel / Drag and half throttle tops out at half of it, coasting slows the car, braking stops a moving car without taking it into reverse, holding the brake once stopped reverses up to ReverseMax, a standing car does not turn and a slow one (under TurnSpeed) turns less than at full lock, reversing turns the nose the other way, above Grip / speed radians a second the car cannot turn tighter, the grass (road false) holds the car to Accel / GrassDrag, and a straight run takes the car as far at 30 ticks a second as at 120

vars.feature: race positions: Race.Standings() returns the car indices (a List<int>) from first to last, and Race.PositionOf(i) the place of car i, 1 for the leader. Cars that have taken the flag come first, in the order they took it (Race.FinishOrder); the rest are ranked by laps completed, then by the gates passed in the lap in progress (LapTracker.GatesPassed), then by the distance still to drive along the track to their next gate (less is ahead), and cars still level by their index
